# Website Conversion Audit

`website-conversion-audit` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Conversion & Web
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/website-conversion-audit/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Why isn't this page converting, and which fixes should we make first?

**Inputs:** A URL or page content/screenshot, and what the page is meant to convert (signup, lead, purchase, demo)

**Output:** A 0–100 conversion score across Message, CTA, Trust, Friction, Speed, and Tracking, a grade, and a prioritized fix list

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill website-conversion-audit`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/website-conversion-audit/resources/score.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/website-conversion-audit/resources/score.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It scores the pass, partial or fail judgements made against the rubric. It doesn't read the page or see real visitor behaviour, so the score is only as good as those judgements.
- Unknown check names and values other than pass, partial or fail stop the run. A check you omit counts as fail and is listed as "Not assessed"; read that line.
- Category weights and grade bands are fixed. The skill says to judge against the page's one goal, but the engine weighs a pricing page and a blog post the same way.
- The fix list follows rubric order, not measured impact. The expected effect of each fix is a judgement, not a forecast.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the page confirms each check against the live page on desktop and mobile and against its one conversion goal, and confirms conversion tracking works before any fix is credited with a lift.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/website-conversion-audit](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/website-conversion-audit)
